base: Single isolated floating island asset for cinematic fantasy portfolio world map. True transparent background. Square composition, full island from roof tips to pointed rocky underside, no cropping. Three-quarter front view slightly above plaza. Warm daylight from upper left, cool shadows, exquisite realistic painterly 3D detail. Top architecture and terraces upper 60%, tapered stone underside lower 40%, two thin waterfalls on front cliff to lower tip. Gold carved details tie the set together. Natural gardens integrated on terraces and cliff edges. NO text labels UI people sky surrounding clouds or other islands. NOT identical white churches; strong unique silhouette.

concepts.about: ABOUT royal library atelier island: broad LOW asymmetrical sandstone palace with copper domed roofs, one modest clock tower, sweeping arcade balconies and open-book crest above inviting warm amber entrance. Autumn golden and apricot trees, sage greenery, flowering courtyard. Warm ochre terracotta ivory palette. Sophisticated ancient scholarly residence. No huge cathedral spire.
concepts.skills: SKILLS arcane research island: open circular teal stone observatory platform dominated by ONE enormous luminous cyan diamond levitating within bronze armillary rings. Three short sculptural dark navy research towers spaced behind, no cathedral, open sky between them. Concentric stepped workshop terraces and blue crystal instruments. Silver-blue and lavender trees with violet flower beds on outer terrace. Teal indigo silver purple palette.
concepts.projects: PROJECTS central imperial citadel island: ENORMOUS towering ivory royal castle complex, tallest very high central spire and dozens of royal-blue roofs on stepped wings, monumental wide ceremonial stairs, blue magical portal at main entrance. Grand sweeping stone terraces, two long waterfalls, banners in blue with no writing. Pale pink white flowering trees and clipped green gardens only on outer terraces to emphasize sheer castle grandeur. Castle occupies most upper area. The most monumental centerpiece, much grander than satellite islands.
concepts.contact: CONTACT beacon harbor island: one slender tall peach-ivory lighthouse with bright warm amber lantern and copper cap, surrounded by LOW crescent terracotta and ivory Mediterranean gothic arcades, open balconies, little bridge and communication terrace. Abundant elegant pink cherry blossom trees and lavender beds naturally framing terraces, green trailing plants on some cliffs. Rose pink apricot warm gold palette, unmistakable LIGHTHOUSE not cathedral.
